remarks:
Escape to the countryside with this exceptional 36 acre recreational property located in the Town of Yorkshire, Cattaraugus County, New York. Accessed by a private driveway from Townline Road, this property offers the perfect combination of privacy, wildlife habitat, and outdoor recreation. The landscape features a diverse mix of mature woodlands, thick brush, and fallow fields, creating ideal cover and natural food sources for whitetail deer, turkey, and other wildlife. A scenic pond provides a peaceful setting for relaxing, fishing, wildlife watching, or simply enjoying the sights and sounds of nature. An existing hunting blind is already in place, making this property ready to enjoy from day one for hunting enthusiasts. The fallow fields and variety of habitat allow for habitat improvements, room for food plots, etc.  Whether you're searching for a private hunting retreat, a weekend getaway, or an investment in Western New York land, this parcel offers outstanding potential with a variety of habitats and excellent opportunities for hiking, ATV riding, camping, and exploring your own land to call your own.
The property is conveniently located near many of the region's premier outdoor destinations, including Bear Creek State Forest, Farmersville State Forest, and Zoar Valley Multiple Use Area, offering thousands of acres for hiking, hunting, fishing, and wildlife recreation. The area is also just a short drive from Allegany State Park, and the villages of Arcade and Ellicottville. If you've been looking for a property that combines privacy, scenic beauty, outstanding wildlife habitat, and convenient access, this approximate 36 acre parcel is a rare opportunity to own your own slice of Western New York's outdoor paradise. 
Along the roadway, Electric utilities are located near the Southeast corner of the property.
